concept.title: Manage alternative authentication options
concept.shortdesc: A recovery code can be used as an alternative authentication factor if your authenticator app is not available.

conbody.note: If you choose not to set up recovery codes, you might lose access to your account.
conbody.p: When updating your signing in options, you might be asked to log in again. This is a normal added security measure. If you cannot successfully log in to your Red Hat account with recovery codes enabled, contact Red Hat Support for assistance in resetting your account.

When you set up recovery codes, you get a list of codes that are unique to your login. Each code can be used once, and the system tracks each code as it is used. You can also remove the recovery codes for your user account.
